title: 🚨 Attention residents! ♻️ Please make sure your recycling is sorted s...
description: 🚨 Attention residents! ♻️ Please make sure your recycling is sorted so we can collect it. 👷 From today (Monday 15 January), crews will be checking recycling for incorrect items and will leave contaminated bins uncollected with a hanger notice in the hope of driving up recycling rates. 🚛 This comes after an extensive campaign was launched to help residents understand what goes where and to cut contamination, which causes whole truckloads of waste that could have been recycled to be burned instead. 🏷 Hangers will explain why a bin wasn't collected and what to do next. Incorrect items will need to be removed from bins so they can be emptied on the next scheduled collection day as it will not count as a missed bin. 💬 Cllr Mel Dawkins, Cabinet Member for Climate Change and Biodiversity, said: “Recycling as much waste as possible has never been more important and is the one thing we can all do to help protect the planet’s resources, reduce our use of raw materials and start to tackle the climate crisis that is happening all around us.” 📈 Our aim is always to maximise how much of your waste we can recycle which means we need to get tougher on contamination that's causing the efforts of many to go to waste. 💬 Cllr Charlotte Cornell, Cabinet Member for Waste and Recycling, added: “Our recycling rates have been low when compared to our neighbouring councils and to the national average for several years now. They have all been rejecting contaminated bins for some time. 💬 “As a mum in a very, very busy household I know everyone wants to recycle properly not least to protect the planet for future generations but it can be confusing. 💬 “The hangers we put on bins are not there to shame you but to give you more information and tips on what to do next time around. 💬 “Our crews have had lots of training and Canenco is just as serious about driving up recycling rates as I am. 💬 “We are all working hard on this together so we’ll take a common-sense approach but this is an issue we really need to get on top of.” ℹ️ Find more information via the link in our bio.
